component.name: Promptly
component.summary: Terminal and SSH client with free, zero-knowledge sync

description.p: Promptly is a terminal emulator and SSH client for phone, tablet and desktop. Hosts, keys and snippets sync between your devices through an encrypted vault kept on storage you already own: a synced folder, or a server you have over SFTP. No account, no servers, no subscription.

Jump hosts, port forwards, tmux-backed persistent sessions, snippets with variables, a file browser over the session's own connection, scrollback search, themes, and a desktop workspace with tabs and split panes.
